map.由柱底轴力与弯矩，按地基承载力计算独立基础底面尺寸并验算基底压力。: Base dimensions of an isolated footing from the column axial force and moment, checked against the soil bearing capacity.
map.基础及土平均重度 (kN/m³): Average unit weight of footing and soil (kN/m³)
map.基底平均压力 p = (N + γ·A·d) / A: Average base pressure p = (N + γ·A·d) / A
map.偏心时 p_max/min = p ± M / W，W = B³/6（方形基础）: Under eccentricity p_max/min = p ± M / W, where W = B³/6 (square footing)
map.本工具按方形基础估算，矩形基础请另行计算: This tool assumes a square footing; calculate rectangular footings separately
map.📚 深度解析：独立基础底面积计算（土木）: 📚 In-depth analysis: isolated footing base area calculation (civil)
map.框架柱独立基础：已知轴力 N 与持力层承载力特征值 fa，求底面尺寸使 pmax: Frame column footings: with the axial force N and the bearing capacity characteristic value f_a of the bearing layer known, solve for the base dimensions so pmax ≤ f_a and the average p ≤ f_a.
map.埋深 d 修正承载力：基础埋深越大，承载力越高，可减小底面但增加开挖量。: Embedment correction: the deeper the footing, the higher the bearing capacity, which can shrink the base but adds excavation.
map.偏心荷载：按 pkmax= N/A + M/W 复核边缘压力，避免一侧脱空。: Eccentric loading: recheck the edge pressure with pkmax = N/A + M/W to avoid lift-off on one side.
map.柱 N=800kN、fa=200kPa、埋深 d=1.5m、土 γ=18kN/m: For column N = 800 kN, f_a = 200 kPa, embedment d = 1.5 m and soil γ = 18 kN/m³: A ≈ N/(f_a − γd) = 800/(200 − 18 × 1.5) = 800/173 ≈ 4.62 m². Take 2.2 × 2.2 = 4.84 m², giving an average p ≈ 165 kPa < 200 kPa, which satisfies the check.
map.平均压力和最大压力都要控？: Do both the average and the maximum pressure need checking?
map.是。轴压看平均 p≤fa；偏压还要 pkmax≤1.2fa 且不脱空（pkmin: Yes. Under axial load the average p ≤ f_a governs; under eccentric load you also need pkmax ≤ 1.2f_a with no lift-off (pkmin > 0). Corner lift-off means the base is too large or the eccentricity too high.
map.底面够大但柱边冲切验算不过时，需加厚基础或设柱墩；冲切与弯矩配筋是独立基础两大控: When the base is large enough but the punching check around the column fails. Then thicken the footing or add a pedestal. Punching and bending reinforcement are the two independent governing checks for an isolated footing.
map.承载力要做深度宽度修正吗？: Does the bearing capacity need depth and width corrections?
map.视土质与基础宽度，黏性土宽度修正系数可取 0；按 GB 50007 用 ηb、η: It depends on the soil and the footing width; for cohesive soil the width correction factor may be taken as 0. Per GB 50007, correct f_a with ηb, ηd and the embedment depth.
